It computes per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds and smooths them with a wrapped 31-day mean. Target day-of-year values 153-244 depend on thresholds for days 138-259, whose pools span May 12 to Sep 20 of each baseline year. The mask compares every 2019-06-01 to 2019-08-31 sea-cell value with these thresholds, then applies run detection and gap joining."}
